# Does a batch of pastured chickens pay you for your time?

> Free pastured poultry profit calculator. Chicks, feed, processing, labour and price per pound in; profit per batch, per bird and per hour, break-even price per pound and mortality and feed sensitivity out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/pastured-poultry-profit-planner/)
